claim: With the PC prefs (no HDR, SSAO, DoF, distortion) every 3D scene draws: (naval: 17 UpdateSurface sea uploads) shadow map; a cleared full-resolution A8R8G8B8 target; half-resolution water reflection and refraction (grid.fx); the main pass (A8R8G8B8 + D24S8 at the backbuffer size); sprites inside the engine's only D3DPERF event "Drawing sneaky sprites"; a 6-draw composite to the backbuffer (the scene/UI boundary); UI on the backbuffer. No depth prepass. The campaign adds a 2400x1350 overlay target (1.25x the backbuffer) after the shadow map, sampled at s10
